title: ID0424412-DC/Si-D/GB-[  MP / R4 170001887 ] SCB fault
description:
Reported issue: SCB fault - please escalate to frontend team. Charger was showing no outlets - L3 re-added outlet group which solved problem, however my SCB view of the charger does not show an outlet group. Refresh of the page (Load Data From Charger) then correctly shows outlet group approx 1 in 3 times. When L2 refresh the page, that instantly shows the outlet group on MY view of SCB. Seems like a database error on the SCB frontend.
Solution: Open ticket in
https://jira.si.siemens.cloud/servicedesk/customer/portal/892/create/8783
under SichargeD Backend
